scenario.opening_question: What fitness class fits our team's energy, schedule, and wellness goals best?

options.name: High-Intensity Interval Training Circuit
options.upside: Maximizes calorie burn and cardiovascular fitness in short time
options.tradeoff: May be too intense for beginners or those with joint issues
options.concern: Risk of injury if form is not carefully monitored
options.best_for: Those prioritizing fast, effective workouts and weight loss

options.name: Gentle Yoga and Stretching Flow
options.upside: Improves flexibility and reduces stress with low injury risk
options.tradeoff: Lower calorie burn and less cardiovascular benefit
options.concern: Might feel too slow or easy for more active participants

options.name: Dance Cardio Fusion Workout

options.tradeoff: Requires coordination and may be challenging for some
options.concern: Noise level might disrupt nearby offices
options.best_for: Those wanting an engaging, upbeat group experience

options.name: Bodyweight Strength and Core Conditioning

options.tradeoff: Can be repetitive and less dynamic than other classes
options.concern: Some may find it less motivating without variety or music
options.best_for: Those focused on strength gains and functional fitness
